statement: For the exact P-192 CM order and the D=-19 control, the squared ray modulus n^2 with n=(pi-1) contains an additive principal-unit subgroup of order r generated by the ray class of (pi); the corresponding group isomorphism from E(Fp) requires an uncomputed point-to-class assignment, while the prime (pi) has residue degree r in the full n^2 ray class field.
